construction_principle: Each pair preserves approximately the same proposition while changing the locus of commitment. The positive pole states the proposition directly, without explicit attribution to a social group. The negative pole attributes the proposition to believers, adherents, practitioners, followers, readers, families, or communities, thereby shifting commitment away from the narrator.

score_interpretation.positive: more direct assertive commitment by the text
score_interpretation.negative: more belief-attributed distancing / commitment shifted to believers or practitioners
